The customer wants the correct power adapter for replacement hub order LM-46855, a non-template written apology, and assurance they will not have to repeat their issue across future support calls. 

So far, the agent apologized, dispatched the correct adapter (tracking LMT-5521-014-IN), and added a history note to the customer's account to prevent repeated explanations. 

Next, the agent will send a personal written apology via email, and the customer will await delivery of the adapter.
